description:
Click & Grow creates zero-effort smart indoor gardens that bridge the gap between modern life and nature. We provide everyone with a chance to experience the benefits of growing healthy herbs, greens and veggies right at home.

Smart Gardens make it possible to grow plants all year round even in the busiest households. They take care of watering, light and nutrients, while the customers reap the benefits.
categories: Home & Tools, Garden & Outdoors, Grocery & Food
affiliate_guide:
Click and Grow Affiliate Program

Commission
We pay a 10% commission for each purchase. This means you can earn anything between $10-240 for a sale! The payouts are made via PayPal at the beginning of each month for accounts that have a balance of at least $50. Please go to Settings --> Payment --> Payment method, pick PayPal, enter your PayPal email address, and click save. If your payment details are not specified, we can not pay you a commission. 

Please note, that Click and Grow has 5 official online stores across 5 different regions. The affiliate link and discount code work worldwide in all of the 5 regional shops but at the moment we can only preview your earned commission in each region separately. To view your commission for other regions (Europe, Asia, Canada and UK) please pick the shop of interest from the top righthand dropdown menu. In case you have any questions, please contact us by sending an email to affiliate@clickandgrow.com.

Cookies 
The cookies track for 45 days. Purchases made after a 45-day period will not be tracked and no commission will be paid. 

Audience discounts
We have created a 10% discount for your audience to use on the Click and Grow online store. The discount will automatically apply when a customer purchases a product using your referral link or uses a discount code at the checkout.
Please keep in mind, that during the Click and Grow in-store seasonal sales your discount code might not work or your audience might want to use the bigger sale discount code instead. In this case please promote your referral link. That allows us to track the purchase, your audience can get a bigger discount and you'll get a commission. If you'd like to change the discount code name, please let us know by writing to affiliate@clickandgrow.com.

Update your affiliate profile
When first logging into your affiliate dashboard please go to Settings and fill in all the data in your profile. Please add your phone number, address, city, zip code, state, country, and all the other necessary details. This is important so we could send you the free test product (if you're eligible) and invite you to take part in different collaborations. 

UpPromote affiliate system guide
Here you can find a quick guide on how to use the UpPromote app and make the most of your resources in order to launch the best promotion campaign. 

Your referral link
You can find your personal referral link on your affiliate dashboard. Add it to the posts talking about Click and Grow products so we could track the sales and pay you a commission for the purchases. Please also promote the referral link during Click and Grow seasonal in-store sales as your personal discount code might not work. Using the referral link your audience can get a bigger discount and you'll get a commission. 

Free test product
Currently, we can only offer a free test product to affiliates whose follower base on their blog, website, or social media is at least 10k. If you feel we should make an exception, please write us at affiliate@clickandgrow.com and we can discuss your case. To receive the free test product please fill in your address as stated in the Update your affiliate profile section and when done, please notify us via email so we could contact you for further details. 

Marketing materials
Under Creatives menu item you will find links to marketing materials and 1-pager. In the marketing materials folder, you can find logos, product photos, banners, and other ready-made visuals which will help you promote Click and Grow products to your audience. 1-pager is a short introduction to Click and Grow brand, our products, and our affiliate program. If there is anything missing, please send us an email.

Important emails
Please check your email provider folders (spam, promotions, social) in case you are not receiving our messages. We will send you info about your earnings and other important updates.

If you have any further questions, please contact us at affiliate@clickandgrow.com.
